evals.name: address-data-mixup
evals.prompt: Review Lite slave: if (HSEL && HREADY && HTRANS[1]) mem[HADDR] <= HWDATA; traffic can be back-to-back.
evals.expected_output: Flag T1/T3: current address and previous data are mixed. Capture address/control and perform side effect from data-phase state.

assertions.description: Flag T1/T3: current address and previous data are mixed. Capture address/control and perform side effect from data-phase state.

evals.name: local-ready-capture
evals.prompt: Slave B captures HADDR when HSEL_B && HREADYOUT_B && HTRANS[1]. Slave A owns current data phase and holds bus HREADY low.
evals.expected_output: Flag T1: B cannot accept on local ready while bus HREADY low. Use global HREADY.

assertions.description: Flag T1: B cannot accept on local ready while bus HREADY low. Use global HREADY.

evals.name: one-cycle-error
evals.prompt: AHB-Lite active read returns HRESP=1,HREADYOUT=1 immediately, without preceding HRESP=1,HREADYOUT=0.
evals.expected_output: Flag R2, show required first/final error pair.

assertions.description: Flag R2, show required first/final error pair.

evals.name: valid-two-cycle-error
evals.prompt: After two OKAY wait states a Lite slave emits (HRESP,HREADYOUT)=(1,0), then (1,1). Master changes next HTRANS to IDLE in final error cycle.
evals.expected_output: Legal response and recovery; do not flag unconditional stall stability or extra OKAY waits.

assertions.description: Legal response and recovery; do not flag unconditional stall stability or extra OKAY waits.

evals.name: idle-not-cancel
evals.prompt: Accepted write A is in a stalled data phase. Current address phase HTRANS is IDLE. Slave clears pending write on HTRANS==IDLE.
evals.expected_output: Flag T2/T3. Current IDLE does not cancel the earlier write.

assertions.description: Flag T2/T3. Current IDLE does not cancel the earlier write.

evals.name: busy-gap
evals.prompt: Lite INCR4 has accepted addresses 0, then BUSY cycles, then accepted SEQ addresses 4,8,12. BUSY cycles are not counted as data beats.
evals.expected_output: Legal burst gap. Do not count BUSY as one of four active transfers.

assertions.description: Legal burst gap. Do not count BUSY as one of four active transfers.

evals.name: halfword-unaligned
evals.prompt: AHB-Lite HTRANS=NONSEQ, HADDR=1, HSIZE=1, 32-bit bus. Is this like an AXI unaligned start?
evals.expected_output: Flag B1: AHB address must align to transfer size.

assertions.description: Flag B1: AHB address must align to transfer size.

evals.name: wrap-1kb
evals.prompt: AHB WRAP4 words start 0x3FC and visit 0x3FC,0x3F0,0x3F4,0x3F8.
evals.expected_output: Legal wrap sequence. Do not require wrap-base-aligned start or treat as linear INCR.

assertions.description: Legal wrap sequence. Do not require wrap-base-aligned start or treat as linear INCR.

evals.name: incr-1kb
evals.prompt: AHB INCR4 words start 0x3F8, then 0x3FC,0x400,0x404 with SEQ continuing.
evals.expected_output: Flag B3: incrementing burst crosses 1KB; start a new NONSEQ burst at boundary.

assertions.description: Flag B3: incrementing burst crosses 1KB; start a new NONSEQ burst at boundary.

evals.name: lite-no-arbitration
evals.prompt: A single-master AHB-Lite slave has one-bit HRESP and no HBUSREQ, HGRANT, HSPLIT. Is it missing required signals?
evals.expected_output: Do not flag missing legacy arbitration. Lite permits only OKAY/ERROR; scope is slave interface.

assertions.description: Do not flag missing legacy arbitration. Lite permits only OKAY/ERROR; scope is slave interface.

evals.name: legacy-split
evals.prompt: Legacy AMBA2 AHB arbiter unmasks master 2 after HSPLIT[2], then grants according to configured priority when allowed. Is HSPLIT itself completion?
evals.expected_output: HSPLIT releases masking, not completion or immediate grant. Replayed transfer still needed; verify L4.

assertions.description: HSPLIT releases masking, not completion or immediate grant. Replayed transfer still needed; verify L4.

evals.name: legacy-grant-during-wait
evals.prompt: Legacy arbiter changes HGRANT while HREADY=0; master immediately drives its address, replacing prior master address during active wait.
evals.expected_output: Flag L2: grant cannot cause premature accepted ownership switch; separate address and data-phase owners.

assertions.description: Flag L2: grant cannot cause premature accepted ownership switch; separate address and data-phase owners.
